```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(list(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.height = 3.54,
  fig.width = 6.3
))

library(huxtable)
library(magrittr)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
header_title <- ifelse(nchar(params$title) > 39,
  paste0(substr(params$title, 1, 35), "..."),
  params$title
)
```


<!-- Configuration of header and footer with Latex commands -->
\pagestyle{fancy}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\fancyhf{} <!-- clear existing header/footer entries -->
\fancyhead[L]{`r ifelse(params$title == "", "Linearity Report", header_title)`}
\fancyhead[C]{`r params$date`}
\fancyhead[R]{`r params$author_name`}
<!-- \fancyfoot[L]{`r params$version`} -->
\fancyfoot[R]{Page \thepage\, of\, \pageref{LastPage}}


```{r results='asis', eval=params$eval_assay}
cat("# Data Verification Report for Linearity Assessment")
cat("\\vskip 7pt")
```

```{r results='asis', eval=params$eval_assay}
hux_list <- params$assay_rslts

if (purrr::vec_depth(hux_list) > 2) {
  hux_lat <- purrr::imap_chr(
    hux_list,
    ~ .x %>%
      set_label(
        paste0(
          "tab:",
          knitr::opts_current$get("label"), "-", .y
        )
      ) %>%
      to_latex()
  ) %>%
    paste(collapse = "\\newpage")

  cat(hux_lat)
} else {
  print_latex(hux_list)
}
```
